name: Connect Tool
description: An opening-route tool crafted at the powered crashed ship to reconnect its console, then used to link interactive parts and inspect signal direction throughout the game.
imageAlt: connect tool image from Scrap Mechanic

sections.heading: How to Get the Connect Tool at the Crash Site
paragraphs: Complete the Water Bucket fire objective, recover the nearby Master Battery, and install it in the crashed ship. Once the ship's Mini Craftbot has power, follow Getting Started and craft the Connect Tool there. Use it on the requested console connection before taking the Logbook and leaving for the Mechanic Station.

sections.heading: How Connections Work
paragraphs: Select the Connect Tool to reveal connection points on interactive parts. Drag from a control part to the part it should operate. The arrows on a completed line show which part sends the signal and which part receives it.

sections.heading: Useful Checks
bullets: Confirm every wheel bearing points in the intended drive direction.
Read Controller connection numbers before changing a sequence.
Trace the signal from a Button, Switch, Sensor, or Seat to the final action.
Disconnect a line before rebuilding a mechanism around a different control.

links.label: Open the Wheel Angle Calculator
links.description: Find separate inner and outer limits before entering Level 5 steering-bearing settings.

seo.title: Scrap Mechanic Connect Tool Location and Uses
seo.description: Craft the Scrap Mechanic Connect Tool at the powered crashed ship, reconnect the console, then use it for bearings, controls, logic, and troubleshooting.

name: Lift
description: A core building tool for creating movable constructions, recovering flipped vehicles, and loading saved creations.

sections.heading: Build and Recover
paragraphs: The Lift creates a stable work platform for vehicles and machines. It is also the quickest recovery tool when a creation flips or becomes trapped in an awkward position.

Place the Lift on clear ground, build above its platform, and use the assigned Lift Up and Lift Down controls to reach the underside of the creation. Removing the Lift returns the creation to normal physics, so lower heavy builds close to the ground before release.

Aim at a loose creation with the Lift equipped to capture it, then place the Lift again at a safer work area. In Creative and supported builder modes, the Lift also opens the blueprint workflow for saving and loading creations.

sections.heading: Test off the Lift
bullets: Remove the Lift before testing wheel rotation, suspension travel, or steering.
Only one Lift can remain placed for each player; placing it again moves the active work platform.
A creation carrying restricted resource objects or produce cargo may need to be unloaded before the Lift can capture it.
Check that the ground below the creation is clear before lowering it.
Use a simple test frame before loading a large saved creation into a new world.
The Lift is a persistent starting tool in Survival and is not intended for normal inventory storage or dropping.

seo.description: Learn how the Lift supports building, saved creations, vehicle recovery, and reliable testing in Scrap Mechanic. Check the related systems first.

name: Sledgehammer
description: The starting Survival tool for melee defense, breaking resource objects, and interacting with loose physics objects.

sections.heading: Create Space Before Swinging
paragraphs: The Sledgehammer is strongest when a single target is controlled in open ground. Pull enemies away from loot, crops, and narrow interiors before committing to close range.
bullets: Use terrain to avoid fighting several bots at once.
Stop collecting resources when the surrounding area is not secure.
Switch to ranged combat when the enemy or environment makes melee unsafe.

seo.title: Scrap Mechanic Sledgehammer - Uses and Guide
seo.description: Use the Sledgehammer for early resource gathering and controlled melee encounters in Scrap Mechanic Survival. Review its role before committing materials.

name: Weld Tool
description: A building tool used to join constructions and move attached sections into a permanent alignment.
imageAlt: weld tool image from Scrap Mechanic

sections.heading: Weld Only After the Motion Test
paragraphs: Joining two sections can remove the separation a mechanism depended on. Test bearings, pistons, clearance, and orientation while the modules are still easy to reposition.
bullets: Save or duplicate a complex module before the final join.
Use visible alignment blocks as temporary guides.
Inspect connections again after welding.

seo.title: Scrap Mechanic Weld Tool - Uses and Guide
seo.description: Join and align Scrap Mechanic constructions safely with the Weld Tool while preserving moving mechanisms. Compare the practical requirements in-game.

name: Paint Tool
description: A color tool for decoration, system labels, safety markings, and color-sensitive automation.
imageAlt: paint tool image from Scrap Mechanic

sections.heading: Create a Small Color Language
paragraphs: Choose a few repeatable meanings: red for stop or danger, blue for water, yellow for moving parts, and another color for player controls. Consistency is more useful than painting every surface.
bullets: Label both ends of long pipe or logic routes.
Use high contrast around moving gaps.
Record sensor colors before repainting a machine.

seo.title: Scrap Mechanic Paint Tool - Uses and Guide
seo.description: Use the Paint Tool for decoration, readable controls, safety markings, and sensor colors in Scrap Mechanic. Check the related systems first.

name: Handbook
description: The in-game reference for core building controls, part placement, connections, and first construction concepts.

sections.heading: Turn Every Page into a Test
paragraphs: The Handbook becomes useful when each control is tried immediately on a small frame. Place, rotate, remove, connect, and test one part before applying the same idea to a vehicle.
bullets: Use the Lift for a disposable practice chassis.
Compare connection arrows before and after reversing a bearing.
Return to the Handbook when a control behaves differently after an update.

seo.title: Scrap Mechanic Handbook - Uses and Guide
seo.description: Use the Scrap Mechanic Handbook with a small test build to learn placement, rotation, removal, and connections. Compare the practical requirements in-game.

name: Claygun
description: A 1.0 terrain-shaping tool that lets mechanics add and remove clay in Creative and Survival.

sections.heading: Terrain Is Now Part of the Build
paragraphs: The Claygun can correct an approach, shape a test area, or integrate a structure with the ground. It should not be treated as a guaranteed defense because 1.0 also introduces enemies capable of digging.
bullets: Keep vehicle clearance in mind when reshaping a road.
Make small changes and test movement before closing a route.
Do not block the only exit from an underground work area.

seo.title: Scrap Mechanic Claygun Terrain Tool - Uses and Guide
seo.description: Use the 1.0 Claygun to shape terrain safely for routes, bases, and underground work in Scrap Mechanic. Compare the practical requirements in-game.
